sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Style processing steps
sections.what: Turns on Tailwind CSS, which generates styles from class names, and autoprefixer, which adds browser-specific CSS prefixes, when the site's CSS is built.
sections.why: Likely reason: Tailwind needs this setup to produce its styles. Reason not stated in the code.
sections.watch_out: Removing either plugin changes the styles produced.

summary: Turns on two style tools that run when the site's CSS is built.
purpose: Makes Tailwind CSS generate styles and adds browser-specific prefixes to CSS.
why: Likely reason: Tailwind needs PostCSS to run. Reason not stated in the code.
how: Exports one settings object that lists Tailwind CSS and autoprefixer as processing steps.
inputs: CSS produced by the project, read during the build.
outputs: Processed CSS with generated styles and browser prefixes.
risks: Plugin names must match installed packages. Removing one changes the styles produced.
debug: If styles are missing or unprefixed, check that these plugins are listed and installed.
